snippet.title: SpeedRunners 2: King of Speed - Steam Playtest Trailer | tinyBuild Connect 2025
snippet.description:
Sign up for the playtest on Steam: https://tblink.co/SpeedRunners2_Steam

SpeedRunners 2: King of Speed is the sequel to the 2016 multiplayer platforming hit where you must outrun your opponents using items, agility, and perfectly timed moves. One of the most notable additions in SR2 is Tournament Mode—a showdown for up to 64 players, where speedrunners compete for the crown.

Want to try the game before launch and help shape its development? Feel free to sign up for the upcoming Steam playtest: https://tblink.co/SpeedRunners2_Steam.

🏆A Short Breakdown of Tournaments:
- 64 players are split into pods of 4
- 4 play-off rounds, single elimination
- Rounds 1–2 (1/8 and quarterfinals): Top 2 players advance
- Rounds 3–4 (semifinals and finals): Only the 1st place advances
- The winner of the final match wins the tournament
- You can spectate tournaments (limited seats per pod)

🏁  🏁  🏁
